patch.summary: SiteGround cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: SiteGround pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: SiteGround cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price SiteGround against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (infrastructure monitoring, log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Intro list price StartUp promo is not the list price ongoing floor. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want managed WordPress hosting with a published list price ongoing floor requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Intro list price StartUp promo is not the list price ongoing floor
Side-by-side cost with WP Engine on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Intro list price StartUp promo is not the list price ongoing floor

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Does not outrank WP Engine (7.7) — specialist managed-WP depth is below the award

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Shared-plan packaging, not Kinsta-style isolated managed WP or Cloudways VMs

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence (landscape vs Plesk)

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git, or a proxy network

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs SiteGround on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model it-development spend with SiteGround in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for SiteGround alongside category cost modelling.
